title: Vadhvan Port Protest Intensifies As Police Detain 20–25 Agitators In Dahanu Amid Service Road Construction, Tensions Rise

ai.summary: Police detained 20-25 protesters at Vadhvan Port site amid tensions over service road construction for the port project, which has been ongoing since November 15 with demands to halt the project and associated infrastructure work.

facts.claim: Police detained around 20 to 25 prominent protesters
facts.quote: police detained around 20 to 25 prominent protesters at Tighare Pada in Vadhvan, Palghar district

facts.claim: The agitation has been continuing since November 15
facts.quote: The agitation has been continuing since November 15, when the Vadhvan Port Virodhi Sangharsh Samiti, along with several political, tribal, fishing and social organisations, launched a protest on the occasion of the 151st birth anniversary of tribal icon Birsa Munda.

facts.claim: Protesters demanded an immediate halt to the Vadhvan Port project and the associated Greenfield Highway works
facts.quote: The protesters have been demanding an immediate halt to the Vadhvan Port project and the associated Greenfield Highway works, maintaining that the developments threaten the interests and livelihoods of local tribal communities, fishermen and residents.

ai.background_note: The Vadhvan Port project faces opposition from tribal communities, fishermen, and residents who fear livelihood impacts from infrastructure development.
